# Mysti

> A beta VS Code extension for working with coding agents, shared context, visual artifacts and explicit multi-agent workflows.

This index describes the 2.0.3 source line. Fetch the smallest relevant guide; settings and command references are generated from the manifest. Account access, native approvals and production acceptance vary by provider. Recordings use labelled sample data. Current source and the production-readiness report take precedence over historical plans. In a checkout, use these repository-relative paths for your revision; the URLs track published main.

## Start here

- [Documentation home](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/README.md): Routes by task and audience.
- [Repository agent guidance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/AGENTS.md): Working conventions and validation commands.
- [Structured navigation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/navigation.json): Topics, audiences and document status.

## Guides and references

- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/GETTING-STARTED.md): Install, connect one provider and complete a first task.
- [Provider setup and compatibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/PROVIDERS.md): Choose and configure adapters; account, model and permission limits.
- [Visual walkthroughs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/walkthroughs/README.md): Choose a practical task with illustrated steps.
- [Multi-agent workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/walkthroughs/multi-agent-workflows.md): Compare independent answers or hand completed work to another agent.
- [Canvas walkthrough](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/walkthroughs/canvas.md): Create a visual design, inspect it and understand persistence and export.
- [Visual Test walkthrough](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/walkthroughs/visual-test.md): Observe a local application, read its report and request a separate fix.
- [History and checkpoints](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/walkthroughs/history-and-checkpoints.md): Reopen, fork, export and understand code rewind boundaries.
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): Diagnose setup, authentication, transport, browser and recovery failures.
- [Backup and recovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/BACKUP-AND-RECOVERY.md): Protect data, export conversations and rehearse upgrade or recovery.
- [Privacy and data controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/PRIVACY.md): Understand data flows, credentials, telemetry and deletion boundaries.
- [Feature guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/FEATURES.md): Chat, context, controls and feature-level guidance.
- [Agent assignments and context mentions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/MENTIONS.md): Tags, roles, dependency ordering and context syntax.
- [Brainstorm](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/BRAINSTORM.md): Discussion strategies, team selection and synthesis.
- [Personas and skills](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/PERSONAS-AND-SKILLS.md): Select or author reusable personas and skills.
- [Context compaction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/COMPACTION.md): Context limits, compaction strategies and tracking.
- [Autonomous mode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/AUTONOMOUS-MODE.md): Autonomy controls, safety classification and limits.
- [Proactive inbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/PROACTIVE.md): Local and connected watches, prerequisites and coverage.
- [Settings reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/SETTINGS.md): Generated contributed keys, declared defaults, scopes and values.
- [Command reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/COMMANDS.md): Generated command IDs, visible titles, keybindings and conditions.
- [Native approval contracts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/NATIVE_APPROVAL.md): Current transport-specific authority and approval boundaries.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Host and webview boundaries, routing, persistence and module map.
- [Developer notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/DEVELOPER-NOTES.md): CLI resolution, native commands, usage accounting and persistence invariants.
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, focused validation and contribution workflow.
- [Maintenance and releases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/MAINTENANCE.md): Required checks, dependencies, runtime constraints and publishing.
- [Production readiness and release checklist](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/PRODUCTION_READINESS.md): Established evidence, remaining acceptance work and reusable release record.
- [Feature demos](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/DEMO_GALLERY.md): Native GitHub players with labelled sample-data demonstrations.
- [Documentation maintenance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/DOCS-MAINTENANCE.md): Update source-backed guides, generated references and discovery metadata.
- [Publishing GitHub demos](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/media/README.md): Upload canonical native videos and verify real playback.
- [Security reporting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/.github/SECURITY.md): Report a vulnerability privately and understand support scope.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/CHANGELOG.md): Versioned changes and unreleased work.
- [Walkthrough screenshot provenance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeepMyst/Mysti/main/docs/media/walkthroughs/README.md): Reproduce the current Visual Test form screenshot and inspect its source hashes.
